notes.title: Roots Sorcery and the Possessed Cultists
notes.notes:
Re-release of the 1st episode, a massive update with many new features!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33622193/b3dec0dc2ce31dd3962210496fe8d5e082d6b033.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33622193/321974f19367466c3922a6560084cda42892ec6e.png[/img][/url]
[u]The Gibbing:[/u]
Rip and tear you enemies apart!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33622193/77fcee07528919fd63ac8d0268954779acbcafb8.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33622193/77fcee07528919fd63ac8d0268954779acbcafb8.gif[/img][/url]
Bloody Roots and the Possessed Cultists:[/u]
Severing the possessed cultists is a hidden danger, as they will grow roots from their wounds, turning into zombies and stalk you. If not noticed, they might take you by surprise on your retreat and take those few health points left and scare the hell out of you!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33622193/7e94630a18c1204abb926a9a5049ef11ff6d88a4.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33622193/7e94630a18c1204abb926a9a5049ef11ff6d88a4.gif[/img][/url]

[u]Sorcery:[/u]
Once you uncover the book of the roots sorcery you will command the roots to tear your enemies or entangle them!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33622193/0252b800fab614b292757899dd0252a25322ab35.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33622193/0252b800fab614b292757899dd0252a25322ab35.gif[/img][/url]

[u]Weapons:[/u]
Behold the mighty flamer! When things get dull flamer will brighten it up! Engulfed with flames enemies will run around becoming an easier target and less of a threat!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33622193/8e6ec6cdb71b44cd19637ec347e6ab492209992c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33622193/8e6ec6cdb71b44cd19637ec347e6ab492209992c.gif[/img][/url]

[u]The sword is now scythe![/u]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33622193/d27e1d5fbc92ff9a05531c738a379c2165fdac2d.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33622193/d27e1d5fbc92ff9a05531c738a379c2165fdac2d.gif[/img][/url]

[u]Laser:[/u]
Laser is now more powerful and acts more like the railguns.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33622193/b568768259f0171aecd3f8b3327d1d9c605b5d53.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33622193/b568768259f0171aecd3f8b3327d1d9c605b5d53.gif[/img][/url]

It tough, it's frenzy, it's the HARDEST CORE!
Bloom: Endless Mayhem
The endless survival mode is here!
Each wave is a monster larger. Each 10th wave got a boss, 20th got two, 30th...make a guess ;)

notes.title: Weapons Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33622193/e7620841a7810383191eb34fce0589c79a2e1f7b.gif[/img]
[u][b]The NAILING![/b][/u]
Nail your enemies to walls and trees with the mighty electric crossbow!
Also now it pins unlimited number of fireballs adding to weapon's deference and offence.

[u][b]Vampiric GLOW[/b][/u]
Glow effect on Vampiric Touch ;)
With Ring of Vampiric Touch in your possession the blades of Punch Daggers and the Claymore now glow in red indicating the necromantic magic sucking life of your enemies!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33622193/0ceaf17090fa6c18f2e0d5bb799df5a2f7b14347.gif[/img]
